title: "Senate Hearings Analysis"
---

## Basic Overview

For this project we built a package that will help when webscraping Senate Hearing data from https://www.govinfo.gov/browse/committee. We have included in this website the full documentation to allow for the recreation of our project using this package along with a written report of our findings. The documentation can be found [here](documentation.qmd) and the written report can be found [here](technical_report.qmd). 

Also included will be a tutorial that will help with clarifying the usage of any functions we included and a link to a streamlit app that hosts a demonstration of our EDA including visuals and explanations of each item. The tutorial can be found [here](tutorial.qmd) and the streamlit can be found [here](technical_report.qmd).
